rows.note: Use 渡輪 as the ordinary all-purpose word for the boat or ship itself.

example.english: We take the ferry across the harbour.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daap3 dou6 leon4 gwo3 hoi2

rows.note: Use 碼頭 for the pier, wharf, or terminal where people board a ferry.

example.english: We wait for the ferry at the pier.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 maa5 tau4 dang2 dou6 leon4

rows.note: Use 渡輪服務 when referring to the ferry service rather than to an individual boat.

example.english: This ferry service starts at six in the morning.
example.traditional: 呢條渡輪服務朝早六點就開始。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 dou6 leon4 fuk6 mou6 ziu1 zou2 luk6 dim2 zau6 hoi1 ci2

rows.note: Use 渡輪公司 when the sense is the company or business operating the ferry service.

example.english: The ferry company says it will run extra sailings tomorrow.
example.traditional: 渡輪公司話聽日會加班。
example.jyutping: dou6 leon4 gung1 si1 waa6 teng1 jat6 wui5 gaa1 baan1
